'''Anand Kumar''' (born 1 January 1973) is an Indian mathematics educator, best known for his [[Super 30]] program, which he started in [[Patna]], Bihar in 2002. He is known for coaching underprivileged students for [[Joint Entrance Examination – Main|JEE–Main]] and [[Joint Entrance Examination – Advanced|JEE–Advanced]], the entrance examinations for the [[Indian Institutes of Technology]] ([[Indian Institutes of Technology|IITs]]). Kumar was named in ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]'' magazine's list of ''Best of Asia 2010''.<ref>{{cite magazine | url=https://content.time.com/time/specials/packages/article/0,28804,1988463_1988996_1988991,00.html | title=The Best of Asia 2010 - TIME | magazine=Time | date=13 May 2010 | last1=Thottam | first1=Jyoti }}</ref> In 2023, he was awarded the [[Padma Shri]], the country's fourth highest civilian award by the [[Government of India]] for his contributions in the fields of literature and education.<ref>{{cite web |title=Padma Awards 2023 announced |url=https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1893797 |website=Press Information Bureau |publisher=Ministry of Home Affairs, Govt of India |access-date=26 January 2023}}</ref>

By 2018, 422 out of 510 students had made it to the IITs and [[Discovery Channel]] showcased his work in a documentary.<ref name="hindustantimes">{{cite news|url=http://www.hindustantimes.com/education/jee-advanced-result-2017-it-is-30-30-for-anand-kumar-s-super-30/story-ZcXXIfQfg20qqHtyXgwERN.html|title=JEE Advanced result 2017: It is 30/30 for Anand ==Early life==

Anand Kumar was born in [[Bihar]], India. His father was a clerk<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://getahead.rediff.com/report/2009/dec/15/meet-anand-kumar-of-super-30.htm |title=He trains India's poorest students for the IIT: Rediff.com Get Ahead |access-date=15 December 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091217080621/http://getahead.rediff.com/report/2009/dec/15/meet-anand-kumar-of-super-30.htm |archive-date=17 December 2009 |url-status=live }}</ref> in the postal department of India. His father could not afford private schooling for his children, and Anand attended a [[Hindi]] medium government school, where he developed his deep interest in mathematics.<ref name="careers360">{{cite web|url=http://getahead.rediff.com/report/2009/dec/15/meet-anand-kumar-of-super-30.htm|title=He trains India's poorest students for the IIT|work=Careers360|date=15 December 2009|access-date=15 December 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091217080621/http://getahead.rediff.com/report/2009/dec/15/meet-anand-kumar-of-super-30.htm|archive-date=17 December 2009|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Super 30 Founder Anand Kumar, a Mathematician on a Mission">{{cite web |url=http://www.successstories.co.in/super-30-founder-anand-kumar-a-mathematician-on-a-mission/ |title=Super 30 Founder Anand Kumar, a Mathematician on a Mission |publisher=Success Stories |date=28 May 2012 |access-date=25 September 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121107065509/http://www.successstories.co.in/super-30-founder-anand-kumar-a-mathematician-on-a-mission/ |archive-date=7 November 2012 |url-status=live }}</ref> He studied at Patna High School, in [[Patna]], Bihar. During his graduation, Kumar submitted papers on [[number theory]], which were published in the ''[[Mathematical Spectrum]]''.<ref name="appliedProbabilityTrust">{{cite web|url=http://www.appliedprobability.org/content.aspx?Group=ms&Page=MS254|title=Letter to the Editor: Happy numbers (page 122 and 123)|access-date=21 September 2019|archive-date=25 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200625212902/http://www.appliedprobability.org/content.aspx?Group=ms&Page=MS254|url-status=dead}}</ref> Kumar secured admission to the [[University of Cambridge]], which he could not attend because of his father's death and his financial condition.<ref name="careers360"/><ref name="tribune">{{cite web|url=http://www.tribuneindia.com/2009/20090614/spectrum/main2.htm|title=Genius at work|work=The Sunday Tribune|first=Uttam|last=Sengupta|date=14 June 2009|access-date=11 July 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090923144049/http://www.tribuneindia.com/2009/20090614/spectrum/main2.htm|archive-date=23 September 2009|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=hin>{{cite news |title=Mr. Cent Per Cent |url=http://www.thehindu.com/arts/article48693.ece |work=The Hindu|date=14 November 2009 |location=Chennai, India |access-date=26 June 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120430012647/http://www.thehindu.com/arts/article48693.ece |archive-date=30 April 2012 |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Teaching career==

In 1992, Kumar began teaching mathematics.<ref name="careers360"/><ref name="Super 30 Founder Anand Kumar, a Mathematician on a Mission"/> He rented a classroom for Rs. 300 per month, and began his own institute, the [[S. Ramanujan|Ramanujan]] School of Mathematics (RSM).<ref name="careers360"/><ref name="deccanherald">{{cite web|url=http://www.deccanherald.com/content/6677/i-am-planning-expansion-super.html|title=I am planning expansion of Super 30|last=Kumar|first=Abhay|work=[[Deccan Herald]]|date=6 June 2009|access-date=18 December 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090924013440/http://www.deccanherald.com/content/6677/i-am-planning-expansion-super.html|archive-date=24 September 2009|url-status=live}}</ref> Within the span of year, his class grew from two students to thirty-six, and after three years almost 500 students had enrolled.<ref name="careers360"/> Then in early 2000, when a poor student came to him seeking coaching for [[IIT-JEE]], who could not afford the annual admission fee due to poverty, Kumar was motivated to start the [[Super 30]] programme in 2002, for which he is now well-known.<ref name="careers360"/><ref name=hin/>

Since 2002, every May, the Ramanujan School of Mathematics holds a competitive test to select 30 students for the Super 30 program. Many students take the test, and eventually, thirty intelligent students from economically disadvantaged sections are selected. He tutors them, and provides study materials and lodging for a year.<ref name="careers360"/> He prepares them for the [[Indian Institute of Technology Joint Entrance Examination|Joint Entrance Examination]] for the [[Indian Institutes of Technology]] (IIT). His mother, Jayanti Devi, cooks for the students, and his brother Pranav Kumar takes care of the management.<ref name="careers360"/><ref name="tet"/>

During 2003 to 2017, 391 students out of 450 passed the IITs.<ref name="careers360"/><ref name="financialexpress">{{cite web |url=http://www.financialexpress.com/news/jee-advance-result-anand-kumars-super-30-wins-laurels-again-27-out-of-30-qualify-for-iits/1262305 |title=JEE advance result: Anand Kumar's Super 30 wins laurels again, 27 out of 30 qualify for IITs' |last=Patna |first=PTI |work=[[Financial Express (India)|Financial Express]] |date=19 June 2014 |access-date=19 June 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140622110218/http://www.financialexpress.com/news/jee-advance-result-anand-kumar-super-30-wins-laurels-again-27-out-of-30-qualify-for-iits/1262305 |archive-date=22 June 2014 |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2010, all the students of Super 30 cleared IIT JEE entrance making it a three in a row for the institution.<ref>{{cite news | work=[[The Hindu]] | title=Super 30's super record in IIT-JEE | url=http://www.thehindu.com/features/education/college-and-university/article438654.ece | date=26 May 2010 | access-date=25 September 2010 | location=Chennai, India | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130731181534/http://www.theHindu.com/features/education/college-and-university/article438654.ece | archive-date=31 July 2013 | url-status=dead }}</ref> Anand Kumar has no financial support for Super 30 from any government as well as private agencies, and manages on the tuition fee he earns from the Ramanujan Institute.<ref name=hin/> After the success of Super 30 and its growing popularity, he received offers from the private sector – both national and international companies – as well as the government for financial help, but he has refused it; Kumar wanted to sustain Super 30 through his own efforts.<ref name=hin/><ref name="tet"/>

From 2006 to 2010, 30 out of 30 students cleared the IIT-JEE.  In subsequent years, the pass rates for the 30 students at the IIT-JEE examinations were: 2011 – 24, 2012–27, 2013–28, 2014–27, 2015–25, 2016–28, 2017–30, and 2018–26.<ref name="tet">{{cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/education/26-students-from-anand-kumars-super-30-academy-crack-iit-jee/articleshow/64529608.cms|title=26 students from Anand Kumar institute Super 30 academy crack IIT-JEE|date=10 June 2018|work=[[The Economic Times]]|access-date=5 June 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190323072226/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/education/26-students-from-anand-kumars-super-30-academy-crack-iit-jee/articleshow/64529608.cms|archive-date=23 March 2019|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news | publisher=[[NDTV]] | title=JEE Advanced 2017 Results | url=http://www.ndtv.com/education/jee-advanced-2017-result-sarvesh-mehtani-from-chandigarh-all-india-topper-punes-akshat-chugh-second-1710638 | date=17 June 2017 | location=Patna, India | access-date=12 June 2017 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170611103712/http://www.ndtv.com/education/jee-advanced-2017-result-sarvesh-mehtani-from-chandigarh-all-india-topper-punes-akshat-chugh-second-1710638 | archive-date=11 June 2017 | url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news | work=[[Times of India|TOI]] | title=26 students from Anand Kumar's Super 30 academy crack IIT-JEE | url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/home/education/news/26-students-from-anand-kumar-super-30-academy-crack-iit-jee/articleshow/64529602.cms | date=10 June 2018 | location=Patna, India | access-date=11 June 2018 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180611132006/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/home/education/news/26-students-from-anand-kumar-super-30-academy-crack-iit-jee/articleshow/64529602.cms | archive-date=11 June 2018 | url-status=live}}</ref>

==Super Infinity==

In 2026, Kumar launched ''Super Infinity'', a digital education initiative intended to make mathematics education more accessible through online learning.<ref>{{cite news |title=Super 30 fame Anand Kumar launches free education platform |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/education/super-30-founder-anand-kumar-launches-free-education-platform-super-infinity-10732953/ |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=11 June 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Super 30 fame Anand Kumar launches “Super Infinity” |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/bihar/super-30-fame-anand-kumar-launches-super-infinity/article70958017.ece |work=[[The Hindu]] |date=8 May 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref> The initiative was formally launched in New Delhi in May 2026, with its online educational programme beginning in June.<ref>{{cite web |title=Super 30 Founder Anand Kumar Launches Super Infinity |url=https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/india-super-30-founder-anand-kumar-launches-super-infinity/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjY6bmV3c21sX01UMVNJUEEwMDBWV000MUc |publisher=Reuters Connect |date=8 May 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref>

The platform offers free online classes, initially focusing on mathematics at the school level and higher levels, with courses intended for different categories of learners and for examinations and competitive examinations.<ref>{{cite news |title=Super 30 fame Anand Kumar launches free education platform |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/education/super-30-founder-anand-kumar-launches-free-education-platform-super-infinity-10732953/ |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=11 June 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref> The classes are made available through the Super Infinity YouTube channel and its website.<ref>{{cite web |title=Super Infinity: An Initiative by Padmashri Anand Kumar |url=https://education.indianexpress.com/web-stories/photostory/super-infinity-an-initiative-by-padmashri-anand-kumar-2534564 |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=10 June 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref>

Kumar has said that Super Infinity uses animation, storytelling and music-based learning techniques to explain mathematical concepts and make learning more engaging. The initiative also includes plans for inspirational films and motivational content aimed at learners.<ref>{{cite news |title=Super 30 fame Anand Kumar launches free education platform |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/education/super-30-founder-anand-kumar-launches-free-education-platform-super-infinity-10732953/ |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=11 June 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Anand Kumar makes maths magic with free online classes for students |url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/west-bengal/kolkata/anand-kumar-makes-maths-magic-with-free-online-classes-for-students-prnt/cid/2171327 |work=[[The Telegraph (India)|The Telegraph]] |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref>

The initiative was conceived as a digital extension of Kumar's educational work through [[Super 30]], with the stated aim of using digital technology to reach a larger number of learners beyond the geographical limitations of the original programme.<ref>{{cite news |title=Super 30 founder Anand Kumar to launch online educational platform |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/education/jee-main-2024-super-30-founder-launch-online-educational-platform-poor-underprivileged-students-9271217/ |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=16 April 2024 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref> The first Super Infinity online class was released in June 2026 and focused on natural numbers. ''The Telegraph'' reported in July 2026 that the class had received about 2.5 million views.<ref>{{cite news |title=Anand Kumar makes maths magic with free online classes for students |url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/west-bengal/kolkata/anand-kumar-makes-maths-magic-with-free-online-classes-for-students-prnt/cid/2171327 |work=[[The Telegraph (India)|The Telegraph]] |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life ==

In 2019, Kumar revealed that he has been suffering from [[acoustic neuroma]], a rare kind of brain tumor, and has lost 80-90% of the hearing in his right ear due to it. He is under treatment of noted neurosurgeon [[B. K. Misra]] at the [[Hinduja Hospital]] in Mumbai.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/bollywood/anand-kumar-reveals-he-has-brain-tumour-says-wanted-super-30-to-be-made-while-i-am-alive/story-yv5RllpXGhwgT5H5O30DiP.html|title = Anand Kumar reveals he has brain tumour, says 'wanted Super 30 to be made while I am alive'|date = 11 July 2019}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 2010, the [[Government of Bihar]] honored Anand Kumar with the Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Shiksha Puraskar, the state’s highest award in the field of education.<ref>{{cite news|title=Anand Kumar awarded Bihar's top education honour|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/education/super-30-anand-kumar-awarded-maulana-azad-shiksha-award-2025-8991224/|newspaper=The Indian Express|date=11 November 2010}}</ref>

In 2018, Anand Kumar was awarded Mahaveer Awards in Chennai for excellence in human endeavour in the field of Education, presented by Bhagwan Mahaveer Foundation.<ref>{{cite news|title= Super 30 Founder Anand Kumar To Receive Mahaveer Award|url= https://www.outlookindia.com/national/india-news-super-30-founder-anand-kumar-to-receive-mahaveer-award-news-372311|newspaper= Outlook|date= 27 January 2021}}</ref>

On 8 November 2018, Anand Kumar was honoured with the Global Education Award<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://globaleducationawards.com/|title=Home – Prime Time Research Media Global Education Awards, Market Research Company|website=globaleducationawards.com|access-date=7 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190307173908/http://globaleducationawards.com/|archive-date=7 March 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> 2018 by [[Malabar Gold and Diamonds|Malabar Gold & Diamonds]] in [[Dubai]]. His efforts in the field of education are considered "pioneering".

Anand Kumar has been felicitated in the US with "Education Excellence Award 2019" by the [[Foundation for Excellence in Education|Foundation For Excellence in Education]] ([[Foundation for Excellence in Education|FFE]]) at a function in [[San Jose, California]].<ref>{{cite news|title= Rashtriya Bal Kalyan Award presented to Super-30 founder |url= https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/nri/nris-in-news/super-30-founder-anand-kumar-felicitated-in-us/articleshow/71194746.cms
|newspaper= The Economic Times |date= 19 September 2019}}</ref> 
Anand Kumar recently awarded with Bharat Ganit Ratna Award 2022- a special award declared by DASA India - National VO operated from Agartala Tripura on 10 March 2022, which has been handed over by [[Anjan Banik]], National Chairman of DASA India.<ref>{{cite news|title= Anand Kumar awarded as Ganit Ratna|url= http://www.northeastcolors.net//index.php?mod=1&pgnum=3&edcode=90&pagedate=2022-3-12&type=a |newspaper= Northeast Color|date= 12 March 2022}}</ref>

In 2023, he was awarded the [[Padma Shri]] by the [[Government of India]] for his contributions in the field of literature and education.<ref>{{cite web |title=Padma Awards 2023 announced |url=https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1893797 |website=Press Information Bureau |publisher=Ministry of Home Affairs, Govt of India |access-date=26 January 2023}}</ref>

== In popular culture ==
Bollywood director Vikas Bahl has directed a film titled ''[[Super 30 (film)|Super 30]]'', with [[Hrithik Roshan]] as Anand Kumar, based on his life and works. The movie was successful at the [[Box office|box]] office.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/bollywood/hrithik-roshan-mathematician-anand-kumar-in-vikas-bahl-super-30-confirmed-4859925/|title=Confirmed! Hrithik Roshan is playing mathematician Anand Kumar in Vikas Bahl's Super 30|date=25 September 2017|work=The Indian Express|access-date=25 September 2017|language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180724093143/https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/bollywood/hrithik-roshan-mathematician-anand-kumar-in-vikas-bahl-super-30-confirmed-4859925/|archive-date=24 July 2018|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="it">{{cite web|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/bollywood/story/super-30-trailer-out-hrithik-roshan-stuns-as-math-wizard-anand-kumar-in-new-film-1542286-2019-06-04|title=Super 30 trailer out. Hrithik Roshan stuns as math wizard Anand Kumar in new film|publisher=[[India Today]]|date=4 June 2019|access-date=4 June 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190604092114/https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/bollywood/story/super-30-trailer-out-hrithik-roshan-stuns-as-math-wizard-anand-kumar-in-new-film-1542286-2019-06-04|archive-date=4 June 2019|url-status=live}}</ref>
[[File:Anand Kumar at the premiere of biopic on his life ‘Super 30’ in 2019.jpg|alt=Anand Kumar at the premiere of biopic on his life ‘Super 30’ in 2019|thumb|Anand Kumar at the premiere of biopic on his life ‘Super 30’ in 2019]]

== Accusations ==
On 23 July 2018, an article in [[Dainik Jagran]] cited former Super 30 students who said that only three students from the program had passed the [[IIT JEE|IIT]] JEE exam that year, contrary to Kumar's claim that 26 had passed.<ref name="India Today">{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/patna-super-30-anand-kumar-1293475-2018-07-23|title=Patna's Super 30 mentor Anand Kumar accused of deceit to gain popularity|date=23 July 2018|work=[[India Today]]|access-date=23 July 2018|language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180725063523/https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/patna-super-30-anand-kumar-1293475-2018-07-23|archive-date=25 July 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> The report also claimed that students who sought to enroll in Super 30 were pushed to enroll in another coaching center called Ramanujan Classes, a for-profit institution, on the pretext that Kumar would coach them if they performed well. Furthermore, the article alleged that by asking IIT aspirants to enroll in Ramanujan Classes, Kumar made over Rs 1 crore annually.<ref name="India Today" />

Deputy Chief Minister of Bihar [[Tejashwi Yadav]] said that "propaganda is being run in media influenced by feudal mindset to discredit and defame Anand Kumar." Union Cabinet Minister [[Shatrughan Sinha]] also supported Kumar on [[Twitter]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment/bollywood/030818/anand-kumar-fighting-a-smear-campaign.html|title=Anand Kumar fighting a smear campaign|work=[[Deccan Chronicle]]|date=3 August 2018|author=Subhash K Jha|access-date=5 June 2019|quote=But ever since the announcement of the project, it seems people are out to discredit Anand’s works.|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190605154114/https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment/bollywood/030818/anand-kumar-fighting-a-smear-campaign.html|archive-date=5 June 2019|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/india-news/super-30-mentor-anand-kumar-gets-support-from-tejashwi-yadav-shatrughan-sinha-amid-charges-of-fabrication/1264394/|title=Super 30 mentor Anand
